name: Repeated authentication failures
description: At least five failed logins for a user in five minutes.

name: Unseen authentication source or device
description: Successful login uses an IP or device absent from at least three prior successful logins.

name: Unusual synthetic location
description: Successful login uses a synthetic location absent from at least three prior successful logins. Location is a simulator label, not real IP geolocation.

name: MFA accepted after unfamiliar login
description: MFA acceptance within five minutes after an unfamiliar successful authentication on the same session.

name: Privileged role assigned
description: A platform administrator role is granted.

name: Privilege follows unfamiliar authentication
description: A privileged role is granted within fifteen minutes of unfamiliar successful authentication for the same user/session.

name: Internal endpoint enumeration
description: At least twelve distinct internal endpoints requested by one user/session within five minutes. Alert emits once per window.

name: Sensitive account resource accessed
description: A successful read targets an explicitly classified sensitive account resource.

name: Abnormal account data volume
description: A successful query accesses at least 1,000 records. Normal synthetic queries access no more than 90.

name: Short-lived privileged role
description: A granted platform administrator role is reverted for the same user within thirty minutes.
